name: Mirabelle
long_description:
We build the personal robot chef.

Mirabelle chops, cooks, and serves fresh meals on demand, so you can eat well every day without spending a minute in the kitchen.

Why now: vision AI is finally good enough to give a machine the eyes of a private chef. And humans gathering around a good meal will always be one of life's best moments.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Two years ago, I moved from a village in the South of France to Paris. I studied CS and economics. I started building my first startup with Alex and we scaled it to 100k+ users in 6 months. Funny cause it was the Duolingo for finding schools but it made us drop out.

We're building Mirabelle (YC W26), your robot chef, to give people back their health and time.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
I started freelancing at 15 doing web scraping, then quickly became a full-stack developer and later an AI engineer training ML and deep learning models.
I dropped out of computer science school to co-found Meoria, a career-guidance app that helped over 100,000 French students navigate Parcoursup.

Now we're building Mirabelle (YC W26), your robot chef, to give people back their health and time.
